## What's new

- **Named deployment accounts.** Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Netlify, Railway, Supabase and Vercel now live in Settings → Integrations. Attach the accounts each squad should use, choose a default, or select an attached account for a command.
- **Deployment setup needs a one-time check.** Existing deployment tokens are imported as disabled, unassigned accounts: validate and enable them, then assign them to the right squads. Old deployment-token host variables are no longer used and should be removed after upgrading.
- **Integration credentials stay per-command.** Notion and deployment tools now receive fresh credentials only for the command that needs them, rather than through generated credential files or shared shell environments. Disabling or unassigning an account revokes that command access.
- **Secret sharing is changing.** The old Secret Store exposure settings for agents and squads have been removed, with automatic cleanup of retired generated files as environments become reachable. Arbitrary exposed values are not migrated; custom Environment Variables and operator secret commands remain available.
- **A live Feed that remembers what you saw.** Completion updates stay in the Feed, with seen state tracked for the rows you actually view. A New updates control brings you back to fresh activity without interrupting your reading; questions and reviews stay in Action Center.
- **Active work stays In Progress.** Work that is still running keeps its active status even while delivery or CI details are present. Those details remain visible alongside it instead of making ongoing work look finished or idle.
- **Clearer remote workspace health.** Squad workspace status shows overload and Docker warnings with a shortcut to Processes. Docker-only problems no longer block ordinary native shell commands, and idle environments explain when assets will refresh on their next start.
- **More reliable recovery controls.** Process actions have bounded waits and independent pending states, so one stuck row does not disable the others. VM-backed workspaces also offer a confirmed Recovery → Restart action for their server without deleting workspace files.
- **Urgent work gets capacity first.** Waiting agents now receive available capacity according to their active work's priority, with first-in-first-out ordering for equal priorities. Existing holders are not interrupted.
- **Federation compatibility note.** This release updates AMTP to 0.2.0. Upgrade connected peers together: handle discovery and attachment downloads to older 0.1 peers mounted under /api require coordinated upgrades.
- **Smaller fixes.** Dependency rows line up more cleanly, process controls fit narrow windows, unsupported log panels stay hidden, and integration credentials and private environment values get stronger output-redaction coverage.
